title: Tafseer in 180 seconds - Videos
description: Welcome to our channel, a guide for those who wish to delve into the depths of the Quran. Here, we comprehensively address the meaning, translation, and exegesis of Quranic verses and chapters. Based on Fahruddin al-Razi's work 'Mefatihu'l-Ghayb', you can listen to verse-by-verse exegesis of chapters like Al-i Imran, and come closer to understanding the universal message of the Quran. Additionally, our short videos explaining the exegesis and translations of certain Quranic sentences and verses will accompany you in your quest for knowledge. Whether you're looking for an overview or an in-depth study, this channel caters to all students and enthusiasts of the Quran. Subscribe and join us on your journey through the knowledge of the Quran.
